group_column: gene (for gene-grouped cross-validation; not a feature)

descriptions.gnomad_af_max: Max of gnomAD exome/genome allele frequency for the exact allele; empty if absent
descriptions.gnomad_absent: 1 if the allele has no gnomAD frequency, else 0
descriptions.blosum62: BLOSUM62 substitution score (wild type to mutant)
descriptions.hydropathy_change: Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy, mutant minus wild type
descriptions.volume_change: Residue volume (A^3, Zamyatnin), mutant minus wild type
descriptions.charge_change: Side-chain charge, mutant minus wild type (D/E -1, K/R +1)
descriptions.to_proline: 1 if the mutant residue is proline
descriptions.from_proline: 1 if the wild-type residue is proline
descriptions.to_glycine: 1 if the mutant residue is glycine
descriptions.from_glycine: 1 if the wild-type residue is glycine
descriptions.from_cysteine: 1 if the wild-type residue is cysteine
descriptions.to_cysteine: 1 if the mutant residue is cysteine
descriptions.rsa: Relative solvent accessibility (Shrake-Rupley SASA / Tien 2013 max)
descriptions.neighbor_count: Residues with CB within 10 A of this residue's CB
descriptions.ss_helix: 1 if the residue is in a helix (DSSP, AlphaFold mmCIF)
descriptions.ss_strand: 1 if the residue is in a strand
descriptions.ddg: FoldX 5.1 BuildModel ΔΔG, kcal/mol, mean of 3 runs (positive = destabilising)
